“Life moves pretty fast. If you don’t stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it.” — Ferris Bueller’s Day Off (1986 film)
Reread weekly review notes in M￼

🍅 ────────────── • At the end of every year, I like to do two things: 1. [Conduct a reflection on the prior year.](https://www.sahilbloom.com/annual-review) 2. [Create a plan for the coming year.](https://www.sahilbloom.com/annual-planning) • My "Past Year Review + Annual Planning" process naturally shifted from focusing on _what I wanted to accomplish_ (New Year's Resolutions) to emphasizing _how I wanted to be_ (New Year's Intentions).

dict.string: The Stop, Stay, Start Audit ────────────── 1. Stop: Things I want to minimize/remove/quit (Never Again), What I want to let go of 2. Stay: Habits and choices worth maintaining, Go all-in, Things I want to maximize/optimize, What I wish I'd done more of 3. Start: What I want to lean into
